blocks.text: Professional and Local TV Removal Services

c: Removing an old TV is easier than you might expect. At Live Junk Free, we provide a quick and reliable TV removal service for any type of television, whether it’s a heavy old CRT, a flat-screen LCD, or a large wall-mounted smart TV. We know how much space an unused TV can take up when it’s no longer working or needed. Our professional service lets you reclaim that space without any heavy lifting or hassle on your part.

The process is designed to be completely stress-free. We start with a free, no-obligation quote so you know exactly what to expect. Once you approve, our experienced team handles everything: safely disconnecting cables, carefully removing wall mounts if needed, lifting the TV out of your home, and ensuring proper disposal or recycling of the old set. We make TV removal so efficient that most jobs are finished in under an hour, leaving your space clean and clutter-free.

items.q: 1. Do you take all kinds of TVs?
a: Yes, we remove big flat screens, old tube TVs, and projectors that are any type. It doesn’t matter if it’s huge or tiny. We’ll remove it safely without any hassle.
We recycle if your TV works, we donate it. If it’s broken, we recycle it properly, not throwing it in the trash. We care about the planet.
The price depends on your TV’s size and where you live. Just call us and we’ll give you a fair price with no surprises. Always free to ask.
We serve in the Greater Toronto Area. Not sure if we will come to you? Just call! We’ll check and let you know right away.
Yes, we can come today and we will remove your TV the same day. Call early to book a quick pickup, and we’ll try our best to reach you as soon as possible.

items.q: 6. Do I need to take it off the wall?
a: No, we can unplug and unmount it for you. But if it’s already down, that’s fine too. We’ll handle it either way.

items.q: 7. Can you take many TVs at once?
a: Sure! Cleaning out a bunch? No problem. Tell us how many you’ve got, and we’ll haul them all in one trip.

items.q: 8. Where does my TV go after?
a: Good TVs go to people who need them. Broken ones get recycled safely, so no harmful stuff in landfills. We make sure it’s done right.
